# UI: the sandbox image recipe, Rebuild and build log in Settings; Start run waits for the build ## What to build graph-manager's web UI (React, `apps/graph-manager/src/web`) gets the controls for the sandbox image that graph-manager builds itself. Settings → Sandbox (`SandboxCard.tsx`) gains an **Image** section: the base image, the apt packages, the extra Dockerfile lines, a collapsible preview of the generated Dockerfile, **Save and rebuild**, **Reset to defaults**, **Rebuild**, the build state and a live build log. The Start run drawer disables **Run in sandbox** while the image builds, with the hint "Building the sandbox image… (Settings → Sandbox)", and re-checks every 5 s. The workspace settings drawer's image hint changes. The server API is defined in the spec `docs/prd/sandbox-image.md` ("Store and routes"); it may be built in parallel by another task, so the UI tests mock `fetch` and must not need the server. API used (from the spec): - `GET /api/sandbox/status` → `{ available: boolean; building?: boolean; reason?: string; defaultImage?: string }`. - `GET /api/settings/sandbox` → `{ limits: { cpus, memoryMb, pids }, recipe: { base: string; packages: string[]; extraLines: string }, defaultRecipe: , dockerfile: string }`. - `PUT /api/settings/sandbox` with `{ recipe }` (or `{ recipe: null }` to reset) → the same shape as the GET; 400 `{ error }` for an invalid recipe (e.g. `extraLines: FROM is not allowed; use COPY --from=`); 409 `{ error }` while building. Limits are still saved with the old flat body `{ cpus, memoryMb, pids }` (keep the existing limits form as is). - `POST /api/sandbox/rebuild` → 202 `{ build }`; 409 `{ error: "the sandbox image is building" }`; 400 `{ error }` when Docker is not available. - `GET /api/sandbox/build` → `{ state: "idle" | "building" | "ready" | "failed"; step?: "clis" | "image"; startedAt?: string; finishedAt?: string; error?: string; log: string[] }`. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `docs/prd/sandbox-image.md` — the spec, section "UI" (test ids and texts). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/SandboxCard.tsx` (~150 lines) — the card: status badge (`data-testid="sandbox-status"`), reason, default image line (`sandbox-default-image`), limits form (`FIELDS`, `save()` with `post(url, body, "PUT")`, `useToast()`), loading pattern with `let alive = true` in `useEffect`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.tsx` — where the card is placed. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.css` (lines ~25–45: `.sandbox-body`, `.sandbox-reason`, `.sandbox-image`, `.sandbox-fields`) — add styles here, using the existing tokens (`--space-*`, `--radius-*`, `--fg2`, `--bad`, `--bad-bg`, `--font-mono`, `--border`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx` (lines ~157–175 the status effect; ~344–375 the switch, reason and image hint with `data-testid="start-run-sandbox-toggle"`, `start-run-sandbox-reason`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.test.tsx` (lines 1–40) — the fetch stub pattern (`stub(post, defaults, gets)`, `json(status, body)`, `vi.stubGlobal("fetch", …)`, `@vitest-environment jsdom`, `ToastProvider`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/WorkspaceSettingsDrawer.tsx` (line ~100) — hint "Needs node 20+ and git. Empty: the default image." - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts` (lines ~99–118) — `SandboxStatus`, `SandboxLimits`, `WorkspaceSettings`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/api.ts` — `api(url)` and `post(url, body, method)`; check how they throw on non-2xx (the error message is the server's `error`). ## Patterns to follow **Loading in an effect** (SandboxCard.tsx): ```tsx useEffect(() => { let alive = true; api("/api/sandbox/status").then( (s) => alive && setStatus(s && typeof s.available === "boolean" ? s : null), () => alive && setStatus(null), ); return () => { alive = false; }; }, []); ``` **Badges**: `available`; tones in use: `ok`, `mute`; use `tone-warn` (if it exists in the CSS, else `tone-mute`) for building and `tone-bad` (or the `field-error` style) for failed — check `src/web/styles` or `index.css` for the tone classes before choosing. **Forms**: `className="forge-form"`, ``, hints `className="field-hint"`, errors `className="field-error forge-error mono" role="alert"`, buttons as in the card's existing Save button. **Texts**: short, plain sentences; no trailing period on labels. ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts` - **IMPLEMENT** `SandboxStatus.building?: boolean`; `export interface SandboxRecipe { base: string; packages: string[]; extraLines: string }`; `export interface SandboxBuild { state: "idle" | "building" | "ready" | "failed"; step?: "clis" | "image"; startedAt?: string; finishedAt?: string; error?: string; log: string[] }`; `export interface SandboxSettings { limits: SandboxLimits; recipe: SandboxRecipe; defaultRecipe: SandboxRecipe; dockerfile: string }`. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/SandboxImage.tsx` (rendered inside `SandboxCard`) - **IMPLEMENT** a component `SandboxImage({ onBuilt }: { onBuilt?: () => void })` with: - Loads `GET /api/settings/sandbox` (recipe, defaultRecipe, dockerfile) and `GET /api/sandbox/build`. - **Base image** input `data-testid="sandbox-base"`. - **Packages** textarea `data-testid="sandbox-packages"`, shown one package per line; on save split on whitespace and newlines, drop empties. Hint: "apt packages from Debian, one per line". - **Extra Dockerfile lines** textarea, monospace, `data-testid="sandbox-extra"`, hint: "Runs after the packages. Use COPY --from= to add a tool from another image. FROM is not allowed." - A `
` **Dockerfile** with a `
` of the server's `dockerfile` (updated from each PUT answer).
  - **Save and rebuild** (`data-testid="sandbox-save-recipe"`, enabled only when a field differs from the saved recipe and no build runs) → `PUT /api/settings/sandbox` `{ recipe: { base, packages, extraLines } }`; on success toast "Saved the sandbox image recipe", refresh the build state and start polling; on error show the message (`data-testid="sandbox-recipe-error"`, `role="alert"`).
  - **Reset to defaults** (`data-testid="sandbox-reset-recipe"`, enabled when the saved recipe differs from `defaultRecipe`) → `PUT { recipe: null }`.
  - **Rebuild** (`data-testid="sandbox-rebuild"`, disabled while building, title "Rebuilds the image and the provider CLIs without the cache") → `POST /api/sandbox/rebuild`; on 202 start polling; on error show the message in `sandbox-recipe-error`.
  - Build state badge `data-testid="sandbox-build-state"`: `building (CLIs)` / `building (image)` (by `step`), `ready`, `failed`, nothing for `idle`. When failed, the error in `data-testid="sandbox-build-error"`. The log in `
` (shown when the log is not empty; max-height ~240px, scrolls, auto-scrolls to the bottom when new lines arrive while the user is at the bottom).
  - Polls `GET /api/sandbox/build` every 2 s while `state === "building"` (clear the timer on unmount and when the state changes); when it leaves `building`, call `onBuilt?.()` so the card refreshes the status (and its Default image line).
- **GOTCHA**: inputs are disabled while loading or saving; the save sends the recipe exactly as edited (the server normalises and answers the stored one — show what it answers).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/SandboxCard.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT** render `` below the default image line (extract the status fetch into `refreshStatus`). The status badge shows `building` (`data-tone="warn"` or mute, glyph ring) when `status.building`. Update the doc comment.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT** when `sandboxStatus?.building`, the switch stays disabled (it already is when `available` is false) and the reason line shows `Building the sandbox image… (Settings → Sandbox)` instead of the server's reason. While the drawer is open and the status says building, re-fetch `GET /api/sandbox/status` every 5 s (clear on close/unmount); when it becomes available the switch is enabled.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/WorkspaceSettingsDrawer.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT** the hint becomes `Needs node 20+, git and glibc (not Alpine). Empty: the image built in Settings → Sandbox.`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.css`

- **IMPLEMENT** styles for the image section: textareas full width (`min-height` ~120px for packages, ~140px for extra lines, monospace), the button row, the `
` preview and the log `
` (`--font-mono`, small font, border, radius, scroll). Light and dark both use the existing tokens; no hard-coded colours.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/SandboxCard.test.tsx` and UPDATE `StartRunDrawer.test.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT** with a fetch stub like `StartRunDrawer.test.tsx`:
  - The card shows the recipe fields from the GET, the Dockerfile preview, and `ready` from the build state.
  - Editing packages enables Save and rebuild; clicking it sends `PUT /api/settings/sandbox` with `{ recipe: { base, packages: [..., "golang"], extraLines } }`; then a building state shows `building (image)` and the log lines; after the stub returns `ready`, the badge says `ready` (use fake timers or `waitFor` with the 2 s poll).
  - A 400 answer shows its `error` in `sandbox-recipe-error`.
  - Rebuild posts to `/api/sandbox/rebuild`; the button is disabled while the state is `building`.
  - A `failed` state shows the error in `sandbox-build-error`.
  - Reset to defaults sends `{ recipe: null }`.
  - Start run: with status `{ available: false, building: true, reason: "building the sandbox image" }` the toggle is disabled and the reason says `Building the sandbox image… (Settings → Sandbox)`; when the next status poll answers available, the toggle is enabled.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- SandboxCard StartRunDrawer`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Settings → Sandbox shows Base image, Packages, Extra Dockerfile lines, the Dockerfile preview, Save and rebuild, Reset to defaults, Rebuild, the build state and the log, with the test ids above.
- [ ] Save and rebuild sends `PUT /api/settings/sandbox` `{ recipe }`; Reset sends `{ recipe: null }`; Rebuild sends `POST /api/sandbox/rebuild`; server errors are shown.
- [ ] While building, the log updates every 2 s and Rebuild/Save are disabled; a failed build shows its error.
- [ ] In Start run, the sandbox switch is disabled with "Building the sandbox image… (Settings → Sandbox)" while building, and enabled once the status is available.
- [ ] The workspace drawer hint mentions glibc and the image built in Settings → Sandbox.
- [ ] Light and dark themes both look right (existing tokens only).
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- SandboxCard StartRunDrawer
npm test -w graph-manager
```
